text:
the sol cubre the muelles alongados and hundidos
in the mar, that salpican cáscaras and tablones.
In the muelles, azúcar, carbón, mulatos, ruidos;
and in the mar, buques, yates, bergantines, ancones.


The onda is blue, is verde; fulge, in lumbradas full,
desde the pétreo castillo that is yergue a the entrada
of the rada; in the orilla of the mar, cocos, arenas.
The luz and the colores anclados in the rada.


Pintados caseríos; cortos and férreos puentes;
muros of España sobre the cambiadiza onda;
jardines polvorosos, quemantes and crujientes;
and the alcatraz, of agudo pico, that hace his ronda.


Saint John junta their piedras, tal as the sky junta
their nubes; and his mole is abrillanta, is afina.
the trópico their pastas of ardor and sueño unta
to the Morro, a Saint Cristóbal and a Santa Catalina.
